text: In June 2021, my office received a petition from local residents requesting changes to parking bylaws on Roden Place in order to improve safety and ease of navigation. Residents reported several areas of concern where parked/stopped vehicles impeded sightlines and the movement of traffic. The request asked for the establishment of new No Stopping areas to allow safe turning on to Roden Place, and for the safe entry and exit to and from driveway and garages. Transportation Services have put forth the following recommendations to support this request from residents.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Roden Place, between McMurrich Street and a point 40.8 metres east. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Roden Place, between a point 49.3 metres east of McMurrich Street and Sarah Street. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Roden Place, between McMurrich Street and a point 9 metres east. 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Roden Place, between a point 9 metres east of McMurrich Street and a point 31.8 metres further east. 5. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Roden Place, between a point 49.3 metres east of McMurrich Street and Sarah Street.
